Title: Generally Available: Terraform support for geo-restore in Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Flexible Server

Body.Content:
You can now use Terraform to perform geo-restore for Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Flexible Server data. This capability enables you to integrate geo-restore activities into your continuous integration (CI) and continuous delivery (CD) pipelines, automating the deployment and management of your database instances.

Learn more.
